_note: Arrow wounds on animals: a hunter's arrow in the flank, shoulder or leg. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the point punching through the coat into the hide. The shaft quivers there and {name} flinches and jerks away.
, the arrowhead tearing into hide that is already torn. Blood wells around the shaft and {name} cries out in pain. The smell of blood thickens.
, and the arrow bites deep into the bleeding wound. Blood runs down {name}'s coat in dark streams and {name} bellows and staggers, eyes rolling.
, and it is too much. {name}'s legs buckle and {name} sags toward the ground, arrows standing from the coat, the cries fading to ragged breaths.
